### Credo to Showcase Broad Portfolio of Connectivity Solutions for AI Scale-Out and Scale-Up Fabrics at 2026 OCP Global Summit


October 9, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/511065572/files/doc_news/Credo-to-Showcase-Broad-Portfolio-of-Connectivity-Solutions-for-AI-Scale-Out-and-Scale-Up-Fabrics-at-2026-OCP-Global-Summit-2026.pdf)


SAN JOSE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcredosemi.com%2F&esheet=54618887&newsitemid=20261009157633&lan=en-US&anchor=Credo+Technology+Group+Holding+Ltd&index=1&md5=171e47fe6466cbba6f8c2340f5730a3e) (Credo) (NASDAQ: CRDO), an innovator in providing connectivity at scale through fast, reliable, and energy-efficient system solutions, will showcase its newest optical and copper interconnect products for scaling AI infrastructure at OCP Global Summit 2026, which takes place October 12-15 at the San Jose Convention Center.


Credo will showcase its newest optical and copper interconnect products for scaling AI infrastructure at OCP Global Summit 2026, which takes place October 12-15 at the San Jose Convention Center.


**Credo Booth Demonstration Highlights (Booth B2, October 13-15)**


- **Micro-Emitter NPO Enabled Optical Backplane for Scale-Up:** Through collaboration with SENKO, Credo has developed a high-reliability micro-emitter blind-mate optical backplane architecture that delivers up to 10x higher bandwidth compared to the latest copper backplanes.
- **1.6T[ZeroFlap Active Light Cable](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcredosemi.com%2Fproducts%2Fzeroflapalc%2F&esheet=54618887&newsitemid=20261009157633&lan=en-US&anchor=ZeroFlap+Active+Light+Cable&index=2&md5=80a25304e6945219af8e5ba782f5e0e9) (ALC):** Closes a mid-reach gap between copper’s distance limits and the power and cost overhead of traditional pluggable optics.
- **1.6T[ZeroFlap Optics](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcredosemi.com%2Fproducts%2Fzeroflap-optical-transceivers%2F&esheet=54618887&newsitemid=20261009157633&lan=en-US&anchor=ZeroFlap+Optics&index=3&md5=95c57bf4c4ad7b7c46a321b2cf1b6657)** : Transceivers featuring Credo’s latest ZeroFlap DSP and integrated silicon photonics, paired with real-time link telemetry through the Credo[PILOT](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcredosemi.com%2Fsolutions%2Fpilot%2F&esheet=54618887&newsitemid=20261009157633&lan=en-US&anchor=PILOT&index=4&md5=da2400e4a9a7e2f1741541fa41ecee3b) observability platform.
- **1.6T[ZeroFlap Active Electrical Cable](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcredosemi.com%2Fproducts%2Fzeroflapaec%2F&esheet=54618887&newsitemid=20261009157633&lan=en-US&anchor=ZeroFlap+Active+Electrical+Cable&index=5&md5=109a15b7d04ecaf96fc94055642a95f7) (AEC)** : Advanced AEC solution delivering high-speed AI interconnects with real-time functional testing, diagnostics, and fault analysis through PILOT.
- [Toucan Gen6 PCIe AEC](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcredosemi.com%2Fproducts%2Fpcie%2F&esheet=54618887&newsitemid=20261009157633&lan=en-US&anchor=Toucan+Gen6+PCIe+AEC&index=6&md5=b114547a823468ac81c3bb0b9e6b40cb) : PCIe rack-level connectivity solution for GPU-intensive AI workloads, using PILOT to provide real-time telemetry and rapid fault isolation; demonstrated on the CWF Intel platform.
- [OmniConnect Weaver](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcredosemi.com%2Fproducts%2Fomniconnect%2F&esheet=54618887&newsitemid=20261009157633&lan=en-US&anchor=OmniConnect+Weaver&index=7&md5=b63de81da932ba6dac1d1ec94f69b020) : Credo’s FPGA-implementation of its memory fanout gearbox (Weaver), breaking the AI inference memory wall; demonstrated with a live, interactive GUI.
- **1.6T[Cardinal DSP](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcredosemi.com%2Fproducts%2Foptical-dsp%2F&esheet=54618887&newsitemid=20261009157633&lan=en-US&anchor=Cardinal+DSP&index=8&md5=1a73a1044b37430874f3a7940cccae7e) +[SiPho](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcredosemi.com%2Fproducts%2Fsilicon-photonics%2F&esheet=54618887&newsitemid=20261009157633&lan=en-US&anchor=SiPho&index=9&md5=d7b6b009fc52a6df8678ed4a26574159) Integration:** A fully integrated optical module pairing Credo’s 1.6T Cardinal DSP with an in-house Silicon Photonics PIC, demonstrating multi-vendor live interoperability.


**Featured Sessions:**


- Executive Session with Credo President and CEO Bill Brennan
***Wider. Slower. Better: Optics That Can Beat Copper*** October 12 at 3:20 p.m. – Lower Level – LL21DE
- Expo Hall Session with Credo AVP of Product LK Bhupathi
***Going Wide: Scalable and Reliable Optical Interconnects for AI Clusters*** October 13 at 3:30 p.m. – Concourse Level – Expo Hall Theater


**Presentations:**


- ***More Signal, Less Noise: Improving AI Cluster Returns Through Standardized Transceiver Telemetry in the OCP Optics Reliability Workstream*** October 13 at 2:05 p.m. – Concourse Level – 210AE
Chris Collins, Credo AVP of Sales & Optical Product Marketing, Credo
- ***Extending Community SONiC for Advanced Optics Telemetry Aligned with OCP Standards*** October 14 at 3:40 p.m. – Concourse Level – 230A
Rajan Pai, VP of Optical Solutions, Credo
- ***An Open Lightweight Serial Interconnect for Composable AI Architectures*** October 15 at 2:15 p.m. – Concourse Level – 211
Vishal Shah, VP of Product, Credo
Allan Cantle, CEO, Nallasway


To request a meeting or product demo, please contactsales@credosemi.com .


**About Credo**


Credo’s mission is to transform connectivity at scale through fast, reliable, and energy-efficient system solutions. Our high-speed copper and optical interconnect technologies deliver industry-leading power and performance from chip to cluster to meet the ever-expanding data infrastructure demands of AI.


Our vertically integrated connectivity portfolio is comprised of our flagship purple ZeroFlap (ZF) Active Electrical Cables (AECs) and ZF optical transceivers; optical components including silicon photonics-based photonic integrated circuits (SiPho PICs) and DSPs; OmniConnect AI memory and chip-to-chip interconnect; and retimers for Ethernet and PCIe—supported by our PILOT diagnostic and analytics software platform. Credo innovations enable our customers to connect the systems that connect the world.
